name: threads-mcp
description: Threads (social): me, publish_text, read_comments, reply_comment, read_mentions, delete, analytics_p

platform_mcp_threads_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_THREADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_threads_access_token.description: Threads user access token (long-lived, 60 days; refresh with GET /refresh_access_token) of the Threads profile, from an app with the Threads use case; scopes threads_basic, threads_content_publish, threads_read_replies, threads_manage_replies, threads_manage_mentions, threads_manage_insights, threads_delete. Sent as the access_token query parameter, as every Threads example does (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/posts).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /me?fields=id,username,name,threads_biography,is_verified ('You may only fetch the profile of the app-scoped user').

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: One call: POST /me/threads with media_type=TEXT and auto_publish_text=true - 'When this optional flag is passed, a Threads post is published automatically when a Threads media container is created without needing to go through the extra publish step. Note: This only works for text posts.' `reply_to` is sent as reply_to_id. Text posts are limited to 500 characters; 250 published posts per 24 h.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: GET /{threads_media_id}/replies 'only returns the top-level replies' (reverse chronological by default); nested replies need /conversation. `username` 'only works for public users and your own user'. Cursor paging: page/limit are not sent.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: A reply is a text post with reply_to_id ('Required if replying to a post') published in one call with auto_publish_text=true.

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.description: GET /me/mentions: 'public Threads media objects in which a Threads profile has been tagged by another Threads profile' (threads_manage_mentions). `since` is not sent (the API takes a Unix timestamp >= 1688540400, not ISO-8601); cursor paging, so page/limit are not sent.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DELETE /{threads_media_id} (threads_delete) answers {success: true, deleted_id}. 'The Delete endpoint has a rate limit of 100 deletes per day per account.'

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: GET /{threads_media_id}/insights?metric=likes,replies,reposts,quotes,views,shares returns data[] entries {name, period: lifetime, values[{value}], id: '<media_id>/insights/<metric>/lifetime'}; the documented example answers in the requested order, which the positional mapping relies on - check raw.data[].name. `post_id` is the first entry's id ('<media_id>/insights/likes/lifetime'). 'An empty array will be returned for REPOST_FACADE posts'. views and shares are 'in development'.
